title: Move both lanyard hooks along, never both unclipped
instruction: Move both lanyard hooks from anchor 1 to anchor 2 and then to anchor 3, one hook at a time: at every moment at least one hook must be in an anchor cup. Finish with both hooks in anchor 3 and let go.
context: Workers at height move between anchors on a twin-leg (Y) lanyard with 100% tie-off: "At least one leg must be anchored at all times" (FallTech MRES01.3 manual, sec. 3.5). Safewaze: connect "the free leg to the next anchor point", then disconnect the other. O*NET 49-9052.00 Telecommunications Line Installers and Repairers: "Participate in the construction or removal of telecommunication towers or associated support structures." Toy-scale mock-up of the clipping order only: no fall loads.
setup: Station table; cm from the midpoint between the arm bases (x forward, y left). Anchors 1-3: grey PLA open-top boxes, inner 10.4 x 5.6 cm, 4 mm walls 2 cm tall, 3 mm floor, centred at x 36, y +17 / 0 / -17, each turned to face the harness (axis 44 / 20 / -14 deg from +x); the wall facing it has two 10 mm slots 2 cm either side of the axis. White cards (4 x 3.2 cm) with black numerals 1-3 at x 45.5 beyond each cup. Harness: orange block 4 x 8 x 4 cm, front face centre at x 7.6, y -10.4, facing 44 deg. Legs: red and blue 6 mm cords, 37.4 cm, anchored 6 mm in front of that face, 2 cm either side of centre (red on the right), running straight at 44 deg through anchor 1's slots; each ends in a black PLA hook block 30 x 14 x 12 mm (15 g), both lying flat in anchor 1.
scoring: Score 0 if: at any moment neither hook block is in an anchor cup; a hook is in anchor 3 without having been in anchor 2; at the end a hook is in no cup or a gripper centre is within 3 cm of a hook block. A hook is in a cup when its centre is inside the cup's inner walls and below the 2 cm rim. Otherwise 0.5 when both hooks are in anchor 2 or 3 (one hook moved alone scores 0), 1.0 when both are in anchor 3. Real trials: judged from video; score 0 if a cup or the harness block moves. Success: 1.0 held 1 s with the cords at rest.
reset_notes: Lift both hooks out, lay both cords straight from the harness block through anchor 1's two slots (red in the slot on the anchor-2 side) and set both hook blocks flat in anchor 1, in line with their cords.
fidelity: Cords: rigid ~2 cm segments with soft bending springs, no twist or stretch. A real snap hook locks onto the anchor; here a hook block in an open cup (held or resting) stands for clipped. Simplified: both hooks start and end in one cup; in real work only one leg stays clipped and the spare is parked on the harness (Safewaze). The harness is a fixed block and no fall loads act. The sim checks the rule every 1/20 s; a real trial checks it from video.
